na mo ārya dzaṃ bha la ya/bse rag bkar thabs mdor bsdus 'dod na/kha 'gong la changs bu ting lo dang kha lhag bo shor na'ang bsdus nas blugs/a kā ro yi byin ga

tei:div.tei:p: na mo ārya dzaṃ bha la ya/ bse rag bkar thabs mdor bsdus 'dod na/ kha 'gong la changs bu ting lo dang kha lhag bo shor na'ang bsdus nas blugs/ a kā ro yi byin gyis brlabs nas/ bse rag kha 'gong mdun du bkug nas/ yi dam sngags la 'di btags thun gyis brab/ nag mo kha tshe thun rbad/ nag mo bya 'gro ma kha chings/ 'grig shog dun hab dul dul nan rbad myag myag bse rag kha chings/ mi la'i kha chings/ chung sri'i kha chings/ nad 'dre'i kha chings/ rabs chad kyi kha chings/ ci mang bzla'o// kyai/ bse rag mi la gzhon nu pa/ bu chung lus la g.yu rna can/ stag ral gzig shubs gri chung rked/ dar zab pad ris phyags lh+wam can/ 'phru btsugs lag na sdud mo gzung*/ sreg pa bdun ni klad na lding*/ ri bong la 'chibs dung so can/ mig rno skra ni kham pa ste/ bse rag ltog 'gong mang pos bskor/ changs bu ting lo kha lhag 'dis/ khyed cag 'khor bcas tshims gyur cig /gnas 'dir ma 'dug gzhan du dengs/ phyin chad 'khor 'dir ma gnod cig /za kha 'thung kha dgra la spos/ zad med za rgyu de na yod/ slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyi/ dam las ma 'da' da song zhig /oṃ sumbha ni sumbha hūm̐ sogs brjod cing phyir dor/ 'di byas pas zho lad chang lad 'o mar mar mi thon pa tshong nyes bor stor shor dang chag grum sogs skam 'gong bse rag gnod pa la phan zhing de ltar phan phyir rā ga a syas 'phral du smras/ maṅga laṃ/// /
